title: Universal Movement Recorder and Playback
features:
Universal Movement Recorder (UMR)
A smooth, lightweight movement recorder and player for Roblox that works in any game. Built with the Nozomi UI for a clean, modern interface, UMR lets you capture your character’s movement as precise keyframes and replay them with buttery-smooth interpolation.

What it does
Records your character’s motion as time-stamped keyframes (position, rotation, velocity).
Replays runs with accurate interpolation and optional camera sync.
Saves and loads runs locally for later reuse and sharing.
Why it’s different
Keyframe-based capture for smooth, stable playback.
Nozomi UI: compact, responsive, and customizable.
“Just works” universally across games; no per-game setup required.
Core features
Recording/playback controls with clear UI.
Optional camera capture during recording.
Noclip toggle for uninterrupted replays.
Save/load recordings as JSON.
Quick teleport to start/end of a run.
Keybinds
X: Start/Stop Recording
C: Play/Pause
V: Toggle Loop
Telemetry
Sends a single, loader-style “UMR-Loader-Open” event on execute.
Includes timestamp, place id, executor, and UMR grouping name.
Uses your site’s API and key; no spam, no extra noise.
Compatibility
Works with major executors.
Optimized for stability; avoids snapback and janky motion.
Designed to coexist with other scripts and overlays.
Use cases
Speedrun route practice
Movement demos/tutorials
Repeatable pathing for testing and QA
Montages and cinematic capture
